title: Article 323 — Reports of Public Service Commissions

content.overview: Article 323 provides that it shall be the duty of the Union Commission to present annually to the President a report on the work done by the Commission, and of a State Commission to present annually to the Governor a report on the work done by the Commission. The President / Governor shall cause the report to be laid before each House of Parliament / the Legislature of the State, together with a memorandum explaining the cases, if any, where the advice of the Commission was not accepted and the reasons for such non-acceptance.
content.glance: UPSC annual report to President → laid before Parliament with memo on non-acceptance of advice. SPSC annual report to Governor → laid before State Legislature with similar memo.
content.study:
Article 323 reporting and accountability:
1. UPSC: annual report to the President; laid before each House of Parliament.
2. SPSC: annual report to the Governor; laid before the State Legislature.
3. Memorandum explaining cases where Commission advice was not accepted and reasons.

This creates political accountability for rejection of PSC advice without making the advice legally binding.

Examination: annual report; laying before legislature; memorandum on non-acceptance.

sections.heading: Key rules
sections.body:
1. UPSC: annual report to President → each House of Parliament + memo on non-acceptance.
2. SPSC: annual report to Governor → State Legislature + memo on non-acceptance.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What reports must Public Service Commissions make under Article 323?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 323, the Union Public Service Commission must present annually to the President a report on the work done by the Commission, and a State Commission must present annually to the Governor a report on the work done by the Commission. The President or Governor shall cause the report to be laid before each House of Parliament or the Legislature of the State, as the case may be, together with a memorandum explaining the cases, if any, where the advice of the Commission was not accepted and the reasons for such non-acceptance.

examTips: Annual report + memorandum explaining non-acceptance of advice.

keyTakeaways: Art 323: PSC annual reports and explanation of non-acceptance of advice.
